command:
set -eu
if ! grep -q '^# [REDACTED]$' /etc/hosts; then
cat >> /etc/hosts <<'ANTRIEB_HOSTS'
# [REDACTED]
10.100.203.10 node1
10.100.203.11 node2
10.100.203.12 node3
10.100.203.13 node4
ANTRIEB_HOSTS
fi
id thanos >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/thanos --shell /usr/sbin/nologin thanos
install -d -m 0750 -o root -g thanos /etc/thanos /etc/thanos/tls
umask 077
printf '%s\n' "$THANOS_CA_CERT" > /etc/thanos/tls/node4-ca.crt
{
  printf '%s\n' 'type: S3' 'config:'
  printf '%s\n' '  bucket: thanos-metrics'
  printf '%s\n' '  endpoint: node4:9000'
  printf '  access_key: %s\n' "$THANOS_S3_ACCESS_KEY"
  printf '  secret_key: [REDACTED] "$THANOS_S3_SECRET_KEY"
  printf '%s\n' '  region: us-east-1' '  insecure: false' '  http_config:' '    tls_config:' '      ca_file: /etc/thanos/tls/node4-ca.crt' '      server_name: node4' '      insecure_skip_verify: false'
} > /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chown root:thanos /etc/thanos/tls/node4-ca.crt /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/tls/node4-ca.crt /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
cat > /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml <<'ANTRIEB_PROM_CONFIG'
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  external_labels:
    cluster: metrics-ha
    replica: node1

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: node
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - node1:9100
          - node2:9100
          - node3:9100
          - node4:9100
ANTRIEB_PROM_CONFIG
chown root:prometheus /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
cat > /etc/default/prometheus <<'ANTRIEB_PROM_ARGS'
ARGS="--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml --storage.tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus/metrics2 --storage.tsdb.retention.time=48h --web.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9090 --web.enable-lifecycle"
ANTRIEB_PROM_ARGS
promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-sidecar.service <<'ANTRIEB_SIDECAR_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos sidecar for Prometheus
Requires=prometheus.service
After=prometheus.service network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=prometheus
Group=prometheus
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos sidecar --prometheus.url=http://127.0.0.1:9090 --tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus/metrics2 --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yml --grpc-address=0.0.0.0:10901 --http-address=0.0.0.0:10902 --consistency-delay=0s --log.level=info
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full
NoNewPrivileges=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/prometheus/metrics2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_SIDECAR_UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable prometheus.service >/dev/null
systemctl restart prometheus.service
systemctl enable --now thanos-sidecar.service
systemctl is-active prometheus.service
systemctl is-active thanos-sidecar.service
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9090/-/ready
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:10902/-/ready

command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | while IFS=' ' read -r ip name rest; do
  [ -n "$ip" ] && [ -n "$name" ] || continue
  grep -q "[[:space:]]$name\([[:space:]]\|$\)" /etc/hosts || printf '%s %s\n' "$ip" "$name" >> /etc/hosts
done
id thanos >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/thanos --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin thanos
usermod -aG prometheus thanos
install -d -o root -g thanos -m 0750 /etc/thanos
printf '%s' "$CA_B64" | base64 -d > /etc/thanos/s3-ca.crt
chown root:thanos /etc/thanos/s3-ca.crt
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/s3-ca.crt
umask 077
cat > /etc/thanos/objstore.yml <<EOF
type: S3
config:
  bucket: thanos-metrics
  endpoint: node4:9000
  access_key: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY}
  secret_key: [REDACTED]}
  insecure: false
  signature_version2: false
  http_config:
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/thanos/s3-ca.crt
      insecure_skip_verify: false
EOF
chown root:thanos /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
cat > /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml <<'PROM_EOF'
global:
  scrape_interval: 5s
  evaluation_interval: 5s
  scrape_timeout: 4s
  external_labels:
    cluster: thanos-metrics
    replica: node1

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: node
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["10.100.175.10:9100"]
        labels:
          host: node1
      - targets: ["10.100.175.11:9100"]
        labels:
          host: node2
      - targets: ["10.100.175.12:9100"]
        labels:
          host: node3
      - targets: ["10.100.175.13:9100"]
        labels:
          host: node4
PROM_EOF
chown root:prometheus /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
chmod 0770 /var/lib/prometheus
chmod -R g+rX /var/lib/prometheus
cat > /etc/default/prometheus <<'ARGS_EOF'
ARGS="--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml --storage.tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus --storage.tsdb.retention.time=12h --storage.tsdb.min-block-duration=2m --storage.tsdb.max-block-duration=2m --web.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9090 --web.enable-lifecycle"
ARGS_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-sidecar.service <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos sidecar
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target prometheus.service

[Service]
Type=exec
User=thanos
Group=thanos
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos sidecar --tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus --prometheus.url=http://127.0.0.1:9090 --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yml --grpc-address=0.0.0.0:10901 --http-address=0.0.0.0:10902 --shipper.upload-compacted
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable prometheus-node-exporter prometheus thanos-sidecar
systemctl restart prometheus-node-exporter
systemctl restart prometheus
systemctl restart thanos-sidecar
printf '%s\n' 'prometheus-and-sidecar-configured'

id thanos >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/thanos --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin thanos

      --version                 Show application version.

Subcommands:
  tools bucket verify [<flags>]
    Verify all blocks in the bucket against specified issues. NOTE: Depending on
    issue this might take time and will need downloading all specified blocks to
    disk.

  tools bucket ls [<flags>]
    List all blocks in the bucket.

  tools bucket inspect [<flags>]
    Inspect all blocks in the bucket in detailed, table-like way.

  tools bucket web [<flags>]
    Web interface for remote storage bucket.

  tools bucket replicate [<flags>]
    Replicate data from one object storage to another. NOTE: Currently it works
    only with Thanos blocks (meta.json has to have Thanos metadata).

  tools bucket downsample [<flags>]
    Continuously downsamples blocks in an object store bucket.

  tools bucket cleanup [<flags>]
    Cleans up all blocks marked for deletion.

  tools bucket mark --id=ID --marker=MARKER [<flags>]
    Mark block for deletion or no-compact in a safe way. NOTE: If the compactor
    is currently running compacting same block, this operation would be
    potentially a noop.

  tools bucket rewrite --id=ID [<flags>]
    Rewrite chosen blocks in the bucket, while deleting or modifying
    series Resulted block has modified stats in meta.json. Additionally
    compaction.sources are altered to not confuse readers of meta.json.
    Instead thanos.rewrite section is added with useful info like old sources
    and deletion requests. NOTE: It's recommended to turn off compactor while
    doing this operation. If the compactor is running and touching exactly same
    block that is being rewritten, the resulted rewritten block might only cause
    overlap (mitigated by marking overlapping block manually for deletion) and
    the data you wanted to rewrite could already part of bigger block.

    Use FILESYSTEM type of bucket to rewrite block on disk (suitable for vanilla
    Prometheus) After rewrite, it's caller responsibility to delete or mark
    source block for deletion to avoid overlaps. WARNING: This procedure is
    *IRREVERSIBLE* after certain time (delete delay), so do backup your blocks
    first.

  tools bucket retention [<flags>]
    Retention applies retention policies on the given bucket. Please make sure
    no compactor is running on the same bucket at the same time.

  tools bucket upload-blocks [<flags>]
    Upload blocks push blocks from the provided path to the object storage.
